About

I'm Nurul Islam Faisal, an independent designer with 10+ years in graphic design, digital design, branding and website design.

I combine design craft, an understanding of how products sell, and AI-assisted workflows to help brands stand out on the shelf and online. I work directly with founders, e-commerce teams and agencies who need reliable design support from concept to print-ready files.

How we work together

A clear path from first message to final files.

  1. Brief

    You share the product, audience, market and any existing brand assets.

  2. Concept

    I develop the direction: layout, typography, color and product hierarchy.

  3. Dieline & layout

    Artwork is built on your printer's dieline with all required information panels.

  4. Revisions

    We refine the design together, including SKU variations and mockups.

  5. Final files

    You receive print-ready, organized files for production.
